Ivy (Partnerships): Heads-up  MedixCare signed an annual renewal for Dedicated plus a pilot to evaluate Private for PHI workloads. Theyre happy to be a marketplace reference and do a short case study. :tada:

Tom (AE): Signed today. 12-month term, two reserved nodes, conversion clause after month 6. They reported a ~33% p50 improvement in the perf run.

Rina (Product): Great. Are they OK with calling out p50 numbers and naming Redwood Optimize? Need Legal clearance for public copy.

Ivy (Partnerships): MedixCare approved naming Redwood Optimize and sharing p50 delta but asked to omit absolute traffic volumes.

Evan (Eng): Will prepare a brief tech appendix (batch_target_ms=30, max_batch=56; kv_cache=on; quant_profile=int8).

Lydia (Marketing): I'll draft announcement + marketplace tile. Adding webinar slot in Aug for joint demo + customer Q&A.

OpsBot: doc-created https://redwood.internal/case-studies/medixcare-draft (partners-access)

Tom (AE): I'll collect a 1-line exec quote from their CTO by Thursday.

Ivy (Partnerships): Adding this to the healthcare wins board. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
